summary_en: Okamura will acquire up to 4.5 million shares (4.7% of outstanding shares) at 2,148 yen per share through ToSTNeT-3 on November 9, 2026, for a maximum total of 9.83 billion yen. The acquired shares and certain existing treasury shares will be cancelled on November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Unsolicited Trading (ToSTNeT-3) and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Okamura's Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury shares and effect their cancellation. The company will execute a single-day share buyback on November 9, 2026, through ToSTNeT-3 (an unsolicited trading system) at the closing price of 2,148 yen per share. The acquisition is limited to a maximum of 4.5 million shares, representing 4.7% of outstanding shares (calculated from 94,903,073 shares outstanding as of October 31, 2026), with a maximum aggregate purchase price of 9.83 billion yen.

The buy order will be placed at 8:45 a.m. on November 9 and is valid only for that trading session. Market conditions may result in partial or no execution of the intended purchase. Following completion of the acquisition, the company will cancel all acquired shares together with existing treasury shares, excluding shares reserved for future restricted stock awards and other intended uses. The cancellation is scheduled for November 30, 2026.

The company undertakes this capital action as part of shareholder returns under its Medium-Term Management Plan 2028 and to enable flexible capital management in response to changing business conditions.
